integrity: Complete analytic proof and reproducible standalone checker; simulated directions serve only as sanity checks. The box-only section law and cubic optimizer are acknowledged as previously indexed; new content is the all-affine pointwise edgewise complementarity and its rhombic-dodecahedral consequences.
limitations: Pointwise identity holds for generic centered sections of a matched pair under every invertible linear map. The three-arcsine probability law and its unique optimizing diagonal shape do not cover arbitrary shears. Degenerate normals excluded. Priority beyond the accessible abstracts and publicly indexed summaries is not independently established.
title: Pointwise complementary sections of boxes and rhombic dodecahedra, with a sharp Haar law
